To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the transcription factor (TF) network of the mouse lung is a highly interconnected network, and that (2) the lung TF network is highly enriched for TFs involved in the regulation of the lung.
The transcriptional network is a complex system of interactions that regulates the expression of genes in the lungs.
we identified a set of novel genes that are differentially expressed in lung cancer and that these genes may be involved in lung tumorigenesis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a computational framework to predict novel components of lung-specific transcriptional networks.
the development of computational methods for the analysis and prediction of novel transcription factor binding sites in DNA.
the computational prediction of novel components in lung transcriptional networks, and the subsequent experimental validation of our predictions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current study provides the first evidence of the involvement of miRNAs in lung development and function.
the transcriptional network of the lung is complex, dynamic and highly regulated.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are developing and applying computational methods to identify and understand the components of lung transcription regulatory networks.
we used computational methods to predict novel transcriptional networks that regulate lung development and function.
we developed computational methods for the identification of novel components of transcriptional networks in the lung.

we can identify new transcriptional networks in human lung cells and predict novel components for these networks.
